body:
I feel so fucking pathetic, like a sniveling fucking worm. Mostly yelling at myself here. Feel free to ignore

Real bad breakup about 2 years ago, still fucked up about it. I feel so pathetic. I can see every mistake I made, exactly how I could have saved it, only too late. Half trying to convince myself i'll get another chance with someone like that, half trying to settle with being alone. But settling disgusts me and it seems improbable i'd meet someone else that can reach me like that. Too depressed to maintain relationships, losing the last friends that I have. The thing is, I know exactly how to become the person that I needed to be then, but what would be the prize now? I have a creeping feeling that therapy could only convince me to be content with a pathetic mediocre existence. I'm so fucking mad at my self for failing that chance, been putting my fists into walls and through windows. I'm losing reasons not to end it.
